	document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
		const languageSwitcherMappings = {
			'ko': 'https://liftoff.ai/ko/',

			'pt_BR': 'https://liftoff.ai/pt-br/',

			'zh-Hans': 'https://liftoff.ai/zh-hans/',
			'en': 'https://liftoff.ai/',
		};

		for (const [dataCode, url] of Object.entries(languageSwitcherMappings)) {
			let languageSwitcher = document.querySelector(`[data-code="${dataCode}"]`);
			
			if(languageSwitcher) {
				languageSwitcher.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
				event.preventDefault();
				window.location.href = url;
			});
		}
		}
	});

<p class="is-style-body-md wp-block-paragraph">Liftoff is thrilled to announce the launch of AppRefinery, our exclusive insights platform designed to revolutionize your approach to app development and growth.</p>



<p class="is-style-body-md wp-block-paragraph">For years, Liftoff’s Mobile App Intelligence has provided deep insights into competitive features, audience motivations, and monetization strategies. AppRefinery expands our intelligence offerings with expert analyses from top industry analysts and real-time benchmarks across diverse mobile business models.</p>



<p class="is-style-body-md wp-block-paragraph">Whether you’re looking to understand industry trends, optimize engagement strategies, or outmaneuver the competition, AppRefinery is your go-to platform for unlocking critical insights at scale.</p>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://info.liftoff.io/app-refinery-schedule-demo" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Schedule a Demo</a></div>
</div>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading is-style-body-md"><strong><strong><strong>Improve Your ROI With Insights for Consumer Apps</strong></strong></strong></h2>



<p class="is-style-body-md wp-block-paragraph">Powered by <strong>intelligence from apps across over 15 categories</strong>—including iGaming, finance and crypto, e-commerce, dating, and education—our platform offers a comprehensive view of the mobile ecosystem, helping you uncover opportunities at scale.</p>



<p class="is-style-body-md wp-block-paragraph">Whatever your goals are, we are here to help.</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>For developers</strong>: Build better apps with actionable insights from our extensive features library.</li>



<li><strong>For marketers:</strong> Attract high-value users with proven motivational models and user archetypes.</li>



<li><strong>For publishers:</strong> Enhance revenue with cutting-edge monetization tactics, including ad monetization, in-app purchases (IAP), and subscription plans.</li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading is-style-body-md"><strong><strong><strong>Our Unique User Motivation Framework</strong></strong></strong></h2>



<p class="is-style-body-md wp-block-paragraph">The key to our approach is our <strong>motivational framework</strong>. AppRefinery built a comprehensive framework based on rigorous research, surveys, and user behavior data to help developers build and scale their apps. By leveraging our extensive data on user behavior, we can provide actionable insights into what drives engagement across app categories.</p>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-large is-resized"><img loading="lazy" decoding="auto" width="993" height="1024" src="https://liftoff.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B-Motivation-Wheel-20240828-135518-1-993x1024.png" alt="" class="wp-image-34112" style="width:238px;height:auto" srcset="https://liftoff.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B-Motivation-Wheel-20240828-135518-1-993x1024.png 993w, https://liftoff.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B-Motivation-Wheel-20240828-135518-1-291x300.png 291w, https://liftoff.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B-Motivation-Wheel-20240828-135518-1-1490x1536.png 1490w, https://liftoff.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B-Motivation-Wheel-20240828-135518-1-64x66.png 64w, https://liftoff.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B-Motivation-Wheel-20240828-135518-1-300x309.png 300w, https://liftoff.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B-Motivation-Wheel-20240828-135518-1-900x928.png 900w, https://liftoff.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B-Motivation-Wheel-20240828-135518-1-1128x1163.png 1128w, https://liftoff.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B-Motivation-Wheel-20240828-135518-1-564x581.png 564w, https://liftoff.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B-Motivation-Wheel-20240828-135518-1-375x387.png 375w, https://liftoff.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B-Motivation-Wheel-20240828-135518-1.png 1581w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 993px) 100vw, 993px" /></figure>



<p class="is-style-body-md wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="is-style-body-md wp-block-paragraph"><strong><strong>AppRefinery’s <strong>User Motivations and Archetypes</strong> data helps you</strong>: </strong></p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Identify your users</strong> and understand why they engage with certain apps.</li>



<li><strong>Uncover key features and strategies</strong> that resonate with your target audience.</li>



<li><strong>Develop a data-driven roadmap</strong> to boost engagement, retention, and monetization.</li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading is-style-body-md"><strong><strong><strong>Get Started With AppRefinery</strong></strong></strong></h2>



<p class="is-style-body-md wp-block-paragraph">Ready to learn more? <a href="https://info.liftoff.io/app-refinery-schedule-demo" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Request a demo</a> today, or contact your Liftoff Account Team to see how you can qualify for AppRefinery access.</p>



<p class="is-style-body-md wp-block-paragraph"><em>Don’t miss our <a href="https://info.liftoff.io/driving-user-engagement-in-igaming-webinar" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">upcoming webinar on iGaming</a>, our first featured genre. Explore how these apps captivate audiences and maximize growth.</em></p>

About Us About Us Investor Relations Careers Contact Us Search for: English Log In Accelerate Monetize Direct GameRefinery Intelligence AppRefinery Intelligence Get started Solutions View Case Studies For Marketers For Agencies For DSPs For Publishers For Mobile Game Developers Products All Products Accelerate Monetize Vungle Exchange Creative Intelligence Resources All Resources Blog Case Studies Events Guides & Reports Podcasts Webinars Help Center Mobile Heroes Company About Us Investor Relations Careers Contact Us Search Language Login Introducing AppRefinery: Liftoff’s Exclusive Platform for Consumer App Insights By Christie Crable | February 11, 2025 AppRefinery , Performance Marketing Liftoff is thrilled to announce the launch of AppRefinery, our exclusive insights platform designed to revolutionize your approach to app development and growth. For years, Liftoff’s Mobile App Intelligence has provided deep insights into competitive features, audience motivations, and monetization strategies. AppRefinery expands our intelligence offerings with expert analyses from top industry analysts and real-time benchmarks across diverse mobile business models. Whether you’re looking to understand industry trends, optimize engagement strategies, or outmaneuver the competition, AppRefinery is your go-to platform for unlocking critical insights at scale. Schedule a Demo Improve Your ROI With Insights for Consumer Apps Powered by intelligence from apps across over 15 categories —including iGaming, finance and crypto, e-commerce, dating, and education—our platform offers a comprehensive view of the mobile ecosystem, helping you uncover opportunities at scale. Whatever your goals are, we are here to help. For developers : Build better apps with actionable insights from our extensive features library. For marketers: Attract high-value users with proven motivational models and user archetypes. For publishers: Enhance revenue with cutting-edge monetization tactics, including ad monetization, in-app purchases (IAP), and subscription plans. Our Unique User Motivation Framework The key to our approach is our motivational framework . AppRefinery built a comprehensive framework based on rigorous research, surveys, and user behavior data to help developers build and scale their apps. By leveraging our extensive data on user behavior, we can provide actionable insights into what drives engagement across app categories. AppRefinery’s User Motivations and Archetypes data helps you : Identify your users and understand why they engage with certain apps. Uncover key features and strategies that resonate with your target audience. Develop a data-driven roadmap to boost engagement, retention, and monetization. Get Started With AppRefinery Ready to learn more? Request a demo today, or contact your Liftoff Account Team to see how you can qualify for AppRefinery access. Don’t miss our upcoming webinar on iGaming , our first featured genre. Explore how these apps captivate audiences and maximize growth. All Products Accelerate Acquire quality users at scale with machine learning Monetize Maximize your earnings for every impression Vungle Exchange Engage high-quality users in their favorite mobile apps Creative Optimize campaign performance with better ad creatives Intelligence Build and launch gaming experiences players want Resources Thought leadership from the global Liftoff community. About Us About Us Investor Relations Careers Contact Us Search for: English Log In Accelerate Monetize Direct GameRefinery Intelligence AppRefinery Intelligence Get started Solutions View Case Studies For Marketers For Agencies For DSPs For Publishers For Mobile Game Developers Products All Products Accelerate Monetize Vungle Exchange Creative Intelligence Resources All Resources Blog Case Studies Events Guides & Reports Podcasts Webinars Help Center Mobile Heroes Company About Us Investor Relations Careers Contact Us Search Language Login Our mission is to connect people to the mobile apps and tools they love How it started Since 2012, we’ve been at the forefront of changing how brands think about growing their app businesses. From being the first to develop an ROI-focused approach to optimizing users to finding new ways of helping mobile businesses get more from their apps, our goal has always been to help mobile app companies connect to their audiences. Today, we challenge the status quo by developing innovative technologies that help you advance app visibility and build your brand in the long term. Better positioned to power your growth In 2021, we merged with our friends at Vungle, creating one of the world’s largest independent—and privacy-friendly—platforms. Together, we’ll deliver even more value to our customers by continuing our work of fueling the entire mobile app transition cycle across user acquisition, engagement, monetization, and analytics. Growing with you Over the last ten years, we’ve expanded our footprint beyond our Redwood City, CA, headquarters. Now, with offices in London, Berlin, and beyond, we’re positioned to meet you wherever you and your users are. liftoff gives Through our Liftoff Gives program, our colleagues can use their skills to give back and help others in their communities. Skills-based volunteering In-person volunteering Employee-inspired giving Learn More Say hi to our leadership team We’re guided by some of the brightest thinkers in our industry. The experience, expertise, and vision they bring to the table will allow our team to continue to scale, grow, and succeed. Executive Officers ABOUT ME Jeremy Bondy is Liftoff’s Chief Executive Officer and a member of its board of directors. Prior to becoming CEO in May 2022, Jeremy served as Liftoff’s President following the company’s merger with Vungle in October 2021. Prior to that, Jeremy served as Vungle’s CEO, beginning in 2020. During his tenure at Vungle, Jeremy built a unified strategy across Vungle’s 11 global offices, representing a publisher base of more than 100,000 active apps, an advertiser base of over 4,500 companies, and leveraging the #1 creative team at scale in the industry. He also spearheaded the company’s inorganic growth strategy, diversifying Vungle’s SaaS offering with the acquisitions of AlgoLift, GameRefinery, and TreSensa, and the company’s emergence in the rapidly growing creator economy with the acquisition of JetFuel. Jeremy Bondy Chief Executive Officer About Me Susan Rickard Hansen has served as Liftoff’s General Counsel since August of 2018. From being an Assistant District Attorney to becoming one of the youngest partners at the respected law firm of Lewis, Brisbois, Bisgaard & Smith, Susan has represented a broad range of clients, many of whom are growth-oriented startup companies and small businesses. While representing these companies, Susan learned an appreciation for the business side of transactions. She uses this experience to advise and assist Liftoff in building a profitable business and highly productive teams, focusing on employment-related legal matters and developing compliance and privacy strategies. Susan Hansen General Counsel About Me Tarek Kutrieh is Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer of Liftoff. Prior to joining Liftoff, Tarek was CFO of VCA Animal Hospitals, the largest network of veterinary hospitals in North America. Prior to that, Tarek held several finance positions at Activision Blizzard. Before joining Activision Blizzard, Tarek was CFO and later President at Directed, parent company to consumer electronics brands Viper and Clifford. Before that, Tarek was an Operating Partner at The Gores Group, a $4 billion private equity fund focused on middle market investments. He started his career with McKinsey & Company. Tarek holds an MBA in finance and marketing from The Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania, where he was a Palmer Scholar, as well as a BS in electrical engineering with distinction from Purdue University. Tarek Kutrieh President and Chief Financial Officer Andre Tutundjian Chief Operating Officer  /  Senior Leadership Bo Chen SVP of Engineering About Me Phil Crosby is co-founder and Executive Product Advisor of Liftoff. His areas of focus include data visualization, data science, and user experience. Prior to Liftoff, he worked as a software engineer building mobile apps in the early days of the iOS App Store, and building video delivery players for the web, both of which have been used by hundreds of millions of people. In his spare time, Phil enjoys creating developer tools and working on open source projects like Vimium. Phil received his BS in computer science from the University of Maryland. Phil Crosby Co-Founder & Executive Product Advisor ABOUT ME Harry Robertson is co-founder and Executive Technical Advisor of Liftoff. He is responsible for the company’s high-performance, high-ownership engineering culture, deep-diving on machine learning initiatives, and setting our performance technology roadmap. Prior to Liftoff, Harry led engineering teams building video analytics and monetization tech, founded a top location-based social network on the iPhone, and built autonomous robots for DARPA. Harry holds a masters in computer science from Stanford University and an MS in mathematics and computer science from École Polytechnique in France. Harry Robertson Co-Founder & Executive Technical Advisor About Me Kristin Seuell leads the Liftoff People team, overseeing global talent management, people operations, employee experience, total rewards, and DEI initiatives. Prior to Liftoff, Kristin led people operations at a leading and successfully exited localization automation SaaS company. Before a career pivot to people operations, Kristin held corporate communications roles at tech leaders eBay and Skype. Kristin Seuell VP of People About Me Scott Silverman is the Chief Revenue Officer of Liftoff, joining the company in 2021 after its merger with Vungle where he held the same role. Prior to Vungle, Scott was a co-founder and CRO of AerServ, a leading mobile in-app exchange and mediation platform. Scott oversaw the sale of AerServ to InMobi, where he went on to lead InMobi’s programmatic exchange and global business development as the VP & GM, Marketplace. Scott’s prior experience also includes various sales, finance, and strategy roles at companies such as Google, dMarc Broadcasting (sold to Google), Brand Affinity Technologies, Classified Ventures, Tribune, PwC, KPMG, and several others. Scott graduated with high honors from Indiana University and received his MBA from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, where he was named a Siebel Scholar.
